flashcard_questions.q: A factor where the risk of injury comes from outside of the body, such as equipment, environment or coaching.
An acronym for the four extrinsic factors: Type of activity, Environment, Equipment, and Coaching/supervision.
A sport in which physical contact between participants is an accepted and expected part of the game, such as rugby, boxing or martial arts.

flashcard_questions.a: A sport in which participants do not make physical contact with each other during normal play, such as swimming, gymnastics or athletics.
An injury caused by repeating the same movement over a long period, leading to gradual damage to muscles, tendons or joints.
